page.overview:
Who is Gorillavark?

The gorillavark spirit used to reside in Sonam's temple before Tagah began to corrupt it with dark energy upon bringing it into the physical world. Shortly after Team Avatar landed in the Spirit World, the gorillavark spirit crashed down onto them from the temple. Satisfied with his landing, he noticed the group getting up beside him. The spirit was thrilled to see humans, proclaiming his love for them. After entering the Spirit World, Team Avatar had their appearances distorted, so upon meeting the group, the gorillavark mistook Aang and Sokka as brothers, Toph as their little sister, and Katara and Zuko as an elderly couple. Aang immediately jumped and clarified that the two were not a couple. The gorillavark, noticing that he had touched a nerve, quickly switched focus to Toph, who had taken the form of an infant. As he brought his finger close to her, the earthbender bit it before Sokka pulled her away and reprimanded her for biting strangers.

Aang called the spirit's attention and asked if he had just come from the temple in the sky. The gorillavark confirmed explaining that it was his "favorite hidey-hole" before the dark energy brought on by Tagah started corrupting the whole place. The Avatar asked the spirit for his assistance in getting up there, stating that it was his duty to stop it, proclaiming his status as the Avatar. The gorillavark, intrigued by his claim, went in for a closer look and a sniff. After excitedly confirming that he was the Avatar, he deduced that the universe had brought them together for a very important mission, building suspense among Team Avatar before shifting emotions and screaming that the mission was to flee.

After burrowing under them, he resurfaced and screamed for them to run for their lives. Taken aback, Team Avatar gave chase as Aang begged the gorillavark, reiterating that both their world were in danger. The spirit, in a moment of cowardly stubbornness, refused to go back up there. Momo, in his altered state, floated up to the great spirit, and he stopped in his tracks. The lemur landed on the gorillavark's nose and let out a single pompous chirp. Hearing this, the spirit determined that Momo had put it in a way that made much more sense. On reflection, the gorillavark decided that he would help Momo and his "human-y friends".

In a single chomp, he scooped Team Avatar into his mouth, visages of the team appearing in the spirit's eyes as he stood upright. He told Team Avatar to not touch any food they found in his teeth, as he was saving it for later, before crouching, swinging his arms, and chanting a countdown. He blasted his head into the sky toward the temple, and Team Avatar popped out of his many eyes as he gleefully proclaimed that though they had not known each other for very long, he loved them. As Team Avatar ascended toward Sonam's temple, the gorillavark's head floated back down toward the ground and he clarified that they did not need to say it back.
